description.text: Pokémon's first yearly Happy Meal card promotion with McDonald's in North America. From 17 June to 7 July 2011, each Pokémon Black•White Happy Meal held one of 12 holo cards and one of eight figures, among them Pikachu, Reshiram and Zekrom. The Pokémon Company International said it would go on to other major markets later in 2011 and in 2012, and it reached Europe and Canada.

sources.title: PocketMonsters.net: Pokémon Kicks off Its McDonald's Happy Meal Promotion in North America This Summer (the 2011 press release)
